parameters.name: CpuAlarmThreshold
parameters.description: The alert threshold for CPU utilization. Unit: percentage.

parameters.name: DiskAlarmThreshold
parameters.description: The alert threshold for disk usage. Unit: percentage.

parameters.name: DuAlarmThreshold
parameters.description: The alert threshold for DTS Unit (DU) usage. Unit: percentage.

parameters.name: MemAlarmThreshold
parameters.description: The alert threshold for memory usage. Unit: percentage.

parameters.name: NoticeSwitch
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the alert feature. Valid values:

*   **1**: enables the alert feature.
*   **0**: disables the alert feature.

parameters.name: Phones
parameters.description: The mobile phone number to which alerts are sent. Separate multiple mobile phone numbers with commas (,).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the Data Transmission Service (DTS) instance resides.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. This parameter is a global parameter and not required.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts create-dedicated-cluster-monitor-rule --instance-id rm-bp1162kryivb80000 --dedicated-cluster-id dts-dasd22000000 --notice-switch 1 --du-alarm-threshold 20 --cpu-alarm-threshold 30 --mem-alarm-threshold 40 --disk-alarm-threshold 100 --phones 18600007654 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id '资源组ID，全局参数，当前API无需传入。' --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts CreateDedicatedClusterMonitorRule --region cn-hangzhou --NoticeSwitch 1 --DedicatedClusterId 'dts-dasd22000000' --Phones 18600007654 --ResourceGroupId '资源组ID，全局参数，当前API无需传入。' --InstanceId 'rm-bp1162kryivb80000' --DuAlarmThreshold 20 --CpuAlarmThreshold 30 --MemAlarmThreshold 40 --DiskAlarmThreshold 100 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
